note: Sonoma County Regional Parks campground on the northern Sonoma Coast near Jenner, in redwood forest up Stockhoff Creek canyon east of Highway 1; the cove beach is across the highway. Electric hookups only at sites 3-5 and 8-10. BOIL WATER NOTICE (on the county page, November 2026): the campground well tested positive for E. coli; boil tap water or bring bottled. --Claude
